title: CellVoteR: Ensemble Cell Type Annotation for Single-Cell RNA-seq
text: CellVoteR ensemble-based pipeline robust cell type annotation single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) data. Rather relying single classification strategy, CellVoteR integrates four complementary annotation methods across two feature spaces, resolves disagreements principled consensus voting step. core design philosophy : Divide conquer — broadly triage cells lineages applying fine-resolution annotation, preventing dominant populations masking rare cell types Redundancy — four methods running parallel reduces sensitivity failure modes single approach Separation concerns — annotation (slow, compute-intensive) consensus resolution (fast, parameter-sensitive) decoupled, user can re-tune voting without repeating pipeline order run complete workflow, CellVoteR requires two inputs supplied: raw gene--cell counts matrix (sparse dgCMatrix, RDS, MTX triplet file). marker configuration — structured list broad fine cell type marker genes.

Tie-breaker agreement — two tie-breakers agree shared label matches leading candidate, label assigned.
